// how this file works: Key = a measure's id (web/scripts/quality/report.mjs); * stands for one part between dots. An exact id wins; otherwise the FIRST pattern that matches, in the order written here. A budget is max, min or equals. `why` is for people. Budgets marked 'ölçülen' follow what was measured on 10 Oct 2026 (a regression gate); the others are limits chosen on principle, and some of them are exceeded today on purpose — that is a finding, not a mistake in the budget.
